purpose: Test whether the only alpha-10 feature candidate that improved all three chronological periods and passed every whole-period shadow robustness condition survives transfer to the independently registered alpha-1 daily-rank Ridge anchor.

baseline.target: within each training day, average percentile rank of observed open-to-close return mapped to [-1,1]
baseline.sample_weight: each training date sums to one
baseline.training: expanding from 2024-01-04, calendar-month retraining, minimum 60 sessions

combination_policy: No combination is tested: H07 was the only generation-2 group with positive uplift in discovery, confirmation A and confirmation B while also passing every whole-period shadow condition.
acceptance_all_required: candidate uplift versus alpha-1 G0 strictly positive in discovery, confirmation A and confirmation B
overall candidate-minus-baseline five-session paired-bootstrap one-sided 80 percent lower bound nonnegative
overall candidate top2 net20 strictly positive
overall candidate top-five-winning-days-removed net20 strictly positive
at least 9 of 13 candidate monthly net20 means positive
at least 3 of 4 candidate fixed blocks net20 positive
overall candidate rank2 standalone net20 nonnegative
promotion: forbidden; passing retains H07 only as a prospective shadow hypothesis
